system.description: Standard on the YVH Battle Droid, a YV Sensor Package can be successfully installed on other Droids, including Mouse Droids (see MSE-6 Repair Droid). The YV Sensor Package features highly specialized sensors calibrated specifically to detect Yuuzhan Vong, including those concealed by Ooglith Masquers or other methods. The YV Sensor Package grants a +10 bonus to Perception checks to detect Yuuzhan Vong within 12 squares and with in line of sight of the Droid.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Scavenger's Guide to Droids
